author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-VoR-HVG-adapt: Residual-Variance HVGs + Adaptive Dual BRBG
abstract: Select HVGs by variance-of-residuals after batch regression (VoR-HVG) using only batch labels; integrate into Dual BRBG with conservative per-PC adaptive residualization (gamma_max=0.74, λ=0.9). Goal: improve ARI/NMI while keeping mixing strong.
